jobs.description:
About AbbVie

AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at www.abbvie.com. Follow @abbvie on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.

Reporting to the Region Counsel, Region North

Position Overview:

Working with the Region Counsel, the role will provide direct country legal support for Scandinavia with a specific focus on Sweden, Denmark and Iceland. The individual will also be part of the management team in Scandinavia and play a leadership role in that forum bringing legal expertise and support on business and culture related matters.

As a strategic business partner, the individual will focus on continuously building an effective legal support function addressing the most pressing legal and external environment challenges and driving/protecting the business in a proactive and creative way.

Highlighted Responsibilities:

• 
Provision of legal advice and support focused on business-oriented solutions on a wide range of matters to colleagues in Scandinavia with a specific focus on Sweden, Denmark and Iceland. Such matters include legal market access issues, medicines tendering, competition law (e.g., supply/distribution related issues), procurement law, pharmaceutical law/advertising, commercial law and general risk management (e.g., ABAC).

• 
The role will require the negotiation and preparation of an extensive range of agreements and, in some cases, negotiations with payors. The individual will need to resolve legal issues using negotiation skills and legal expertise.

• 
Monitor and proactively address with cross functional partners including GM, Government Affairs and Market Access changes in laws and the external environment that affect the business. For example, the dynamic in Denmark created by the US Most Favored Nation pricing policy (MFN). This part of the role will include driving AbbVie’s objectives at the Legal Committee of the LIF in Sweden and support creation of a legal committee in LIF Denmark.

• 
Devise legal strategy and support in cross functional meetings including MLOR meetings (Medical/Legal/OEC/Regulatory).

• 
Provide training on new developments and key legal topics of importance. Develop practical checklists and working tools for the business to facilitate their work.

• 
Represent AbbVie externally to customers, suppliers, wholesalers, competitors, government agencies.

• 
To the extent that complex problems or specific technical expertise is required, select and direct the work of outside counsel.

• 
Continuously develop a solid knowledge of AbbVie´s business and organization and knowledge of the broader business impact of decisions made.

• 
Lawyer qualified in Sweden or Denmark.

• 
Law school degree.

• 
At least 6 years of professional legal expertise, preferably in an international environment, ideally at a law firm and/or multi-national company.

• 
Experience in supporting senior business leaders.

• 
Deep understanding of Scandinavia market and culture.

• 
Highly motivated, flexible, independent with capability to manage people and take initiative. Strong integrity, and strong communication skills.

• 
Ability to prioritize and manage workload across the team and with outside counsel where needed.

• 
Solution-oriented, with ability to proactively identify solutions to complex legal and business challenges.

• 
Based in Sweden.

• 
Prepared to travel to Denmark and other RN markets as required.

• 
Fluent in English.

**At Danfoss Climate Solutions, we engineer leading energy-efficient solutions that accelerate the green transition and shape a more sustainable tomorrow. As our new Technical Product & Portfolio Manager, you will play a pivotal role at the intersection of business strategy and technology, turning emerging opportunities into high-impact, revenue-generating solutions.

By connecting strategic vision with practical execution, you will drive customer-centric innovation, transforming existing offerings and unlocking new business models across growth domains such as Data Center Cooling, Digital Services, and Connected Infrastructure Solutions.

Working within the Digital Application Solutions team, you will collaborate closely with business leaders, domain experts, R&D, and engineering teams to identify new opportunities, shape portfolio priorities, and bring concepts from exploration through implementation to deliver measurable business impact.

• Shape the Digital Portfolio: Own and refine the Digital Application Solutions portfolio, roadmaps, backlogs, dependencies, and key decisions.

• Modernize & Expand Offerings: Create new digital value propositions from existing Danfoss products and services to reach new markets.

At PriceShape, we are looking for a VP New Sales to take ownership of New ARR across Europe and globally. You will be responsible for defining the sales strategy, building and leading a high-performing sales organisation, and creating a scalable operating model that delivers predictable growth.

This is a senior commercial leadership role combining revenue ownership, strategic leadership, organisational design, and commercial execution. You will lead our Head of Sales and Head of Outreach and, through your leadership team, be responsible for building scalable teams that consistently generate qualified pipeline, convert opportunities into customers, and establish PriceShape’s position as the market leader.

You will report to the CRO and work closely with Revenue Operations, Marketing, Product, Customer Success, and the executive leadership team.

The role can be based in either our headquarters in Aarhus, Denmark, or our office in Stockholm, Sweden. As the Sales organisation is spread across both locations, the role requires a fair amount of presence and travel between the two offices to ensure close collaboration with the team and strong alignment across markets.

What You’ll Do

Revenue Ownership & Growth Strategy

• 
Own and deliver the company's New ARR targets

• 
Translate company growth objectives into regional strategies, sales targets, and organisational plans

• 
Ensure predictable pipeline generation, conversion, and forecasting

• 
Drive commercial initiatives that unlock new revenue opportunities

• 
Monitor business performance through leading indicators, including pipeline coverage, win rates, deal velocity, and forecast accuracy

Sales Leadership & Organisational Scaling

• 
Lead, Coach and develop the Head of Sales and Head of Outreach to drive strong performance, develop their teams, and deliver against the overall sales strategy

• 
Build a high-performance culture focused on accountability, execution, and continuous improvement

• 
Design and scale the sales organisation to support ambitious growth across European markets

• 
Ensure consistent leadership practices, performance management, and coaching across teams

• 
Raise the leadership bar through succession planning, talent development, and organisational capability building

Outreach & Pipeline Generation

• 
Own the outbound pipeline generation strategy across Europe

• 
Ensure the outreach organisation consistently delivers high activity levels and qualified meetings with the right Ideal Customer Profiles (ICPs)

• 
Define activity standards, productivity targets, and quality expectations

• 
Drive continuous optimisation of outbound messaging, targeting, sequencing, and conversion rates in partnership with Marketing and Revenue Operations

• 
Ensure seamless collaboration between Outreach and Sales to maximise meeting conversion and pipeline creation

Go-to-Market Execution

• 
Define and continuously improve a scalable and repeatable sales operating model

• 
Drive consistent execution of qualification, pipeline management, forecasting, and CRM discipline

• 
Partner closely with Revenue Operations to optimise processes, reporting, and sales productivity

• 
Collaborate with Marketing and Product to improve positioning, messaging, and commercial execution

• 
Ensure effective collaboration and handoff between Sales and Customer Success to maximise long-term customer value

Customer Quality & Market Leadership

• 
Ensure teams consistently acquire high-quality customers that fit our Ideal Customer Profile (ICP)

• 
Maintain strong qualification standards across all regions and sales teams

• 
Partner with Product and Marketing to evolve ICPs, market segmentation, and commercial strategy

• 
Balance growth with customer quality to drive long-term retention and sustainable revenue

Hiring & Leadership Development

• 
Own the hiring and development of Heads of Sales and other senior commercial leaders

• 
Build the organisational structure needed to support continued European expansion

• 
Make decisive performance management decisions where necessary

• 
Ensure scalable onboarding, leadership development, and career progression across the sales organisation in partnership with Revenue Operations and P&C

New ARR achieved vs. target

• 
Pipeline generated

• 
Pipeline coverage and forecast accuracy

• 
Qualified meetings booked

• 
Outbound activity levels

• 
Win rate

• 
Average deal size and sales cycle length

• 
Customer quality and retention of new customers

• 
Time-to-productivity for new hires

• 
Sales productivity across regions

Leadership bench strength and employee retention

Who You Are

You are an experienced B2B SaaS sales leader who has successfully scaled sales organisations across multiple markets. You combine strong commercial judgement with a structured and analytical approach, and you are comfortable operating at both strategic and operational levels.

You have experience leading leaders, building organisational capability, and creating the structures and operating rhythms needed to deliver predictable growth.

Skills and Experience

• 
10–15+ years of experience in B2B SaaS sales, including leadership of leaders

• 
A proven track record of scaling high-performing sales organisations across multiple markets

• 
Experience leading Heads of Sales or equivalent senior sales leaders

• 
Strong experience driving predictable New ARR growth in a fast-scaling SaaS environment

• 
Experience selling to both SMB and Enterprise customers

• 
Experience within e-commerce and brands

• 
Demonstrated success building scalable sales processes, forecasting, and operating rhythms

• 
Strong commercial judgement with a deep understanding of ICP, segmentation, and revenue strategy

• 
Excellent analytical and strategic thinking skills

• 
Experience building and scaling sales teams across Europe

•

A senior leadership role with significant ownership of PriceShape’s New Sales organisation and growth

• 
The opportunity to shape and scale our commercial organisation across European markets

• 
Close collaboration with the executive leadership team and key functions across the business

• 
A culture built on trust, ownership, and high performance

PriceShape is an international SaaS company headquartered in Aarhus, Denmark. Our platform helps retailers and brands increase revenue and profitability through dynamic pricing and competitor tracking.

We value work-life balance, trust, and both personal and professional growth. We offer flexible hours, social events, pension and health insurance, great facilities, and an in-house canteen.

Hamamatsu Photonics is an exciting, inspiring place to work where we encourage both personal and career development. To support our plans, we are now expanding our team as we are looking for Senior Electronics Engineers.

**About Us

**Hamamatsu Photonics is a dynamic, international high-tech company and a leader in the development, manufacturing, and supply of high-performance lasers and photonic crystal fibers. We employ some of the best and most creative people in our industry and together we have established one of the fastest growing and most innovative photonics companies in the world.

We embrace a culture in which a healthy work-life balance is encouraged; and we promote a positive, supportive working environment. To support our growth plans, we are investing in our facilities and growing our talented teams. We provide a great place to work with good people and exciting, industry-leading products.

**THE ROLE

**You will be working with a mix of custom-made technologies and ground research. You will design, develop and implement electronic systems and laser products throughout the entire product lifecycle. You will closely collaborate with experts in your own and other fields to meet the demanding requirements. The products you develop are typically low volume but high margin, reflecting the complexity and effort put into each system. You are prepared to learn to interpret and scope fuzzy customer requirements.

• Be responsible for Electronics development for laser products throughout the entire product lifecycle.

• Work closely with experts from other areas like optics and mechanics on system design.

• Take ownership of project work packages within product development projects; work with project managers to ensure delivery of solutions within the planned deadlines and budgets.

• Interact with project and product stakeholders and communicate information clearly across the R&D organization.

• Form new and innovative design concepts and take ownership of electronics system designs.

• Create reference designs for other electronics designers in our organization.

• Support manufacturing of existing laser products, custom orders, product improvement activities.

• Ensure product compliance and certification according to industry standards

**THE IDEAL CANDIDATE

**

• Experience from senior roles in developing advanced PCBs for complex systems spanning the complete product life cycle.

• Strong communication and collaboration skills engaging with management and other engineering disciplines.

• Proven track record of successful PCB productization.

• Deep domain knowledge in at least one of the following areas: analog design, power supplies, control loops, digital interfaces or low noise designs.

• Detailed knowledge of state of the art electronic and software technologies.

• Experience of working with external partners.

• A scientific mindset, out of the box thinker but still with a practical approach.

• Master’s degree in electronics or similar.

• English – both oral and written

**WE OFFER

**Professional challenges in a highly dynamic and growing business environment with enormous potential for further growth. An opportunity to become part of a successful, enthusiastic, development team in an informal workplace. Competitive employment terms and benefits, good work-life balance, and influence on own tasks. Experienced and skilled colleagues with highly diverse backgrounds in an international organization.

**Keep your personal data safe

You also have a role to play in keeping your personal data safe. We request you only submit personal data about yourself in your job application, CV / Résumé or other relevant material you choose to provide to us that is relevant for the specific job opening you are applying for.

Please consider whether there is personal information you are about to submit, such as health information, information on family relations, information on trade union membership, etc. that is not necessary for our recruitment process or the job opening you are applying for. Please also be aware that certificates or other documents are not necessary for the vacancy. We urgently request you to redact/cross out such information before you submit your job application.

Thank you.

SOUNDBOKS is an innovative tech company and aspiring lifestyle brand. You may have seen us at a music festival, street party, or your friend’s celebration (think: private events combining festival-grade sound with beat-enhancing lights) where special moments are turned into memories. We create the loudest, most durable, and arguably coolest Bluetooth speakers and audio reactive lights on the market.

At SOUNDBOKS, trust and community go hand in hand. People are encouraged to take ownership of their work while knowing they have the support of the team behind them. Voices are heard, ideas are welcomed, and collaboration is what pushes us forward.

This is more than a job - it’s a community where people care about each other, celebrate together, and share the energy of creating something meaningful. Life at SOUNDBOKS is bold, fast, and full of passion - for the product, for the mission, and for showing up as your true self. With 70 team members, this is a place where you can do your best work and truly belong.

ROLE ACOUSTIC ENGINEER

TEAM PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT

HOURS FULL TIME

LOCATION COPENHAGEN, DENMARK

START DATE OCTOBER 2026 or ASAP

The Product Development team at SOUNDBOKS is the group responsible for the exciting product journey, taking every step of the development process toward and into mass production. In it’s heartbeat you’ll find collaborative and self-driven team members with a large cross-discipline understanding tied to ownership. They are there to make a difference - for the products, the team and the SOUNDBOKS customers as a whole.

Every SOUNDBOKS starts with a great idea - but turning it into a speaker that can survive a festival, run for hours, and sound incredible takes a lot of engineering. As the Acoustic Engineer, you'll be taking charge of the acoustic development that helps bring those products to life.

Okay, let’s make things a little more concrete. Here’s what we expect your daily life to look like:

Concept & Prototype Development

• 
You'll select and design acoustic components based on product and market requirements.

• 
You'll define initial enclosure concepts.

• 
You'll build and evaluate proof-of-concept prototypes to validate acoustic concepts.

• 
You'll collaborate with Mechanical Engineering during the early product development phase to mature acoustic concepts.

Simulation & Validation

• 
You'll perform acoustic simulations with a focus on sound pressure level (SPL), sound quality, and system efficiency.

• 
You'll validate simulation results through physical testing.

• 
You'll collaborate with suppliers to refine acoustic components based on simulation and test results.

Driver Specification & Verification

• 
You'll own the technical specification of loudspeaker drivers towards suppliers.

• 
You'll define driver specifications and tolerances.

• 
You'll support manufacturing verification with suppliers.

• 
You'll participate in the acoustic verification of the final product towards mass production.

• 
You'll collaborate with the Audio team on audio signal handling, including crossovers, compressors, and limiters.

In order to become a success in this role, we believe that your profile should be aligned with the bullets listed below. However, we acknowledge that success can take many forms, so please do apply even if you don’t tick all the boxes.

• 
You have proven experience designing and simulating loudspeakers, including transducer design and specification, enclosure design, and acoustic measurements.

• 
You hold a BSc or higher in Audio, Acoustics, Mechanical, or a related engineering discipline.

• 
You've done loudspeaker simulation and measurements, and use both to validate and refine your designs.

• 
You've worked with loudspeaker development from concept through verification and ideally have experience collaborating with external manufacturing partners.

• 
Familiarity with crossover design, FEM simulations, or failure analysis is an advantage.

• 
Ideally you also have experience building physical speaker mock-ups or collaborating with large-scale loudspeaker manufacturing partners.

• 
You work independently, take ownership of your area, and enjoy collaborating closely with engineers across disciplines.

• 
You're curious, creative, and constantly looking for ways to improve acoustic performance.

• 
You're drawn to what SOUNDBOKS is building and are excited to be a part of the journey!

Intrigued? At SOUNDBOKS you’ll find yourself a part of a community. We realize that growth is a process and we don’t expect you to go through it alone. Actually, we guarantee that you won’t have to. We work together in order to work smarter, we inspire each other to be better, and we never forget that every member of the team is responsible for our success.

So, if you’re tired of all of the noise in the job market, we’d love to hear from you. This may be the coolest job you ever have!

3Shape and DTU Compute (Department of Applied Mathematics and Computer Science at the Technical University of Denmark) invite applications for an Industrial Postdoctoral position partially funded by Innovation Fund Denmark. The position is a 2-year fixed-term appointment starting in January 2027 (small variations in the start date may be possible depending on the candidate’s preference).

The project addresses a fundamental challenge in computational imaging and large-scale optimization: how can uncertainty in measurements be quantified, propagated, and ultimately leveraged to improve the reliability of reconstructed 3d models?

Modern 3D scanning systems rely on advanced optimization algorithms to reconstruct geometry and color from large volumes of sensor data. While these algorithms produce highly accurate results, they typically provide limited information about the confidence and uncertainty associated with the reconstructed output. Developing methods that can efficiently estimate and propagate uncertainty in the input data through large-scale iterative optimization algorithms has the potential to improve reconstruction quality, enable more informed algorithmic decisions, and support the next generation of intelligent scanning systems.

The successful candidate will conduct research at the intersection of numerical linear algebra, optimization, uncertainty quantification, and computational imaging. The project will investigate: (i) how to characterize measurement uncertainty, (ii) how uncertainty propagates through iterative solvers, (iii) how to develop new mathematical frameworks for uncertainty-aware optimization, and (iv) how to validate the proposed methods through simulations and deployment in medical 3D reconstruction algorithms developed at 3Shape.

The position offers a unique opportunity to combine fundamental research with industrial impact. Working closely with leading researchers at DTU and engineers at 3Shape, the candidate will contribute to scientific publications, software prototype development, and innovation activities aimed at strengthening the theoretical foundations and practical performance of future 3D scanning technologies.

About us

At 3Shape we aim to advance dental treatment and diagnostics with advanced software and 3D scanners designed for dental professionals across the globe. Our purpose is to advance innovation in dentistry, continuously enhancing patient care and outcomes.

This role places you at the heart of our technological advancements within Product Creation, namely TRIOS & SCANNER SW, offering the chance to shape the trajectory of our innovative products and software applications.

About the project

The project is a 2-year project between 3Shape and the Technical University of Denmark, partly funded by Innovation Fund Denmark. The academic co-supervisor will be Professor Per Christian Hansen at DTU Compute (Department of Applied Mathematics and Computer Science).

The research focuses on uncertainty-aware methods for large-scale linear least squares problems, which form the mathematical backbone of many inverse problems and optimization tasks in 3D reconstruction. The objective is to develop new theoretical and computational tools for quantifying and propagating uncertainty through iterative solution methods, and to translate these developments into practical algorithms for medical 3D reconstruction systems.

What You’ll Do

In this role, you will contribute both to the theoretical foundation and the practical implementation of next-generation uncertainty-aware reconstruction algorithms. The work spans mathematical modelling, algorithm design, and software development in a medical imaging 3D reconstruction.

Develop methods for characterizing measurement uncertainty in medical 3D scanning data, including data-driven approaches and machine learning methods where appropriate, to obtain realistic and application-relevant uncertainty models.

• 
Work hands-on with numerical algorithms, including iterative methods such as Krylov subspace methods and related solvers.

• 
Develop and analyse new methods for uncertainty-aware linear least squares optimization, with a focus on large-scale iterative solvers.

• 
Design mathematical frameworks for quantifying how uncertainty evolves through optimization algorithms used in 3D reconstruction.

• 
Contribute to the architectural design of uncertainty-aware components within existing reconstruction pipelines.

• 
Translate theoretical models into efficient, scalable implementations suitable for industrial use.

Experience with or strong interest in uncertainty quantification, statistical modelling, or probabilistic methods.

Strong programming skills in at least one programming language (ideally two), such as C#, C++, or Python.

Familiarity with machine learning methods is an advantage, particularly for data-driven modelling of complex systems.

Ability to work independently and take ownership of research problems while also contributing to a collaborative industrial-academic environment.

Strong communication skills and the ability to present complex mathematical ideas clearly in both academic and applied settings.

A Snapshot of Your Day

Join our Development Denmark team in a role focused on validating and qualifying grid measurement systems used in wind park control applications. Your day may start in the laboratory testing Elspec G4K/G4N grid meters, evaluating measurement accuracy and communication performance under different operating conditions. You will work hands-on with measurement hardware, analyze complex datasets, and develop automated test solutions using Python and MATLAB.

Working closely with engineering, cybersecurity, SCADA, and supplier teams, you will help ensure that grid measurement systems meet performance, reliability, and security requirements. Your work will directly contribute to supplier evaluations and the successful integration of measurement technologies within wind power plant control solutions.

How You’ll Make an Impact

• 
Validate and evaluate grid measurement devices used in wind park control systems, with a primary focus on Elspec G4K/G4N meters, supporting supplier qualification and technology assessments.

• 
Design, execute, and automate test campaigns using Python and/or MATLAB, including integration with Omicron signal generators, measurement equipment, data acquisition systems, and structured CI/CD testing frameworks.

• 
Troubleshoot measurement hardware, communication interfaces, and laboratory test setups to identify, analyze, and resolve performance issues.

• 
Analyze measurement data from devices, SCADA systems, and SQL databases, transforming results into clear technical insights, reports, visualizations, and recommendations that support engineering decisions.

• 
Verify secure communication and cybersecurity requirements, including protocols such as Modbus/TLS and Syslog/TLS, certificate-based authentication, secure onboarding, logging and telemetry capabilities, and compliance with IEC 62443 and emerging Cyber Resilience Act (CRA) requirements.

What You Bring

• 
Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline, combined with relevant professional engineering experience.

• 
Experience working with electrical measurement systems, power systems, data acquisition equipment, or similar industrial technologies, including structured troubleshooting and root cause analysis.

• 
Proficiency in Python application development for test automation, data analysis, and software development, with a strong analytical and problem-solving mindset.

• 
Experience with CI/CD practices, agile development methodologies, C# and/or C++.

• 
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across multidisciplinary teams.

• 
Familiarity with industrial communication protocols, cybersecurity principles, and secure system integration, including areas such as PKI certificates, authentication mechanisms, secure communication interfaces, or IEC 62443-based environments.

About the Team

You will join the Development Denmark team, where engineers collaborate to validate grid measurement systems used in wind park control and power plant environments. The team combines hands-on laboratory testing with advanced data analysis to assess performance, troubleshoot technical challenges, and support supplier evaluations.

Knowledge sharing, peer reviews, and open collaboration are an integral part of the team's way of working. While the role offers a high degree of ownership and independent responsibility, you will be supported by experienced colleagues who work together to solve complex engineering challenges and deliver trusted measurement solutions.
